name: CSS Global
format:
<style>
    :root {
        --azul-fundo: #031123;
        --azul-1: #071f3d;
        --azul-2: #0b315b;
        --azul-card: rgba(8, 31, 61, 0.94);
        --azul-card-2: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        --laranja: #ff7a00;
        --laranja-claro: #ffb347;
        --branco: #ffffff;
        --cinza-texto: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.78);
        --verde: #35ff6b;
        --vermelho: #ff4d4d;
        --borda: rgba(255, 122, 0, 0.28);
        --sombra: 0 4px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
        --raio: 16px;
        --fonte: 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif;
    }

    body,
    #app,
    .v-application,
    .v-main,
    .v-container,
    .nrdb-ui {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--azul-fundo) 0%, var(--azul-1) 45%, var(--azul-2) 100%) !important;
        color: var(--branco) !important;
        font-family: var(--fonte) !important;
    }

    * {
        font-family: var(--fonte) !important;
    }

    .v-toolbar,
    .v-app-bar {
        background: #020b18 !important;
        color: var(--branco) !important;
        border-bottom: 2px solid var(--laranja) !important;
        box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.45) !important;
        min-height: 64px !important;
    }

    .v-app-bar .v-toolbar__content,
    .v-toolbar .v-toolbar__content {
        display: flex !important;
        align-items: center !important;
        min-height: 64px !important;
        gap: 10px !important;
    }

    .v-toolbar-title,
    .v-app-bar-title {
        color: var(--branco) !important;
        font-weight: 900 !important;
        letter-spacing: 0.2px !important;
        margin-left: 8px !important;
    }

    .v-app-bar .v-toolbar__content::before,
    .v-toolbar .v-toolbar__content::before {
        content: "";
        display: block;
        width: 1px;
        height: 1px;
        margin-left: auto;
        flex-shrink: 1;
    }

    .v-app-bar .v-toolbar__content::after,
    .v-toolbar .v-toolbar__content::after {
        content: "";
        display: block;

        /* LARGURA TOTAL DO BLOCO DOS DOIS LOGOS */
        /* Aumente se os logos ficarem muito próximos. */
        width: 290px;

        height: 54px;

        background-image: url("data:image/png;base64,"), url("data:image/png;base64,");

        /* TAMANHO DOS LOGOS */
        /* Primeiro valor = CEESP */
        /* Segundo valor = UFSM */
        /* Exemplos:
           background-size: 190px auto, auto 48px;  -> CEESP menor e UFSM maior
           background-size: 220px auto, auto 42px;  -> CEESP maior e UFSM menor
        */
        background-size: 200px auto, auto 68px;

        background-repeat: no-repeat, no-repeat;
        background-position: left center, right center;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: 18px;
        flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .v-navigation-drawer {
        background: #020b18 !important;
        color: var(--branco) !important;
        border-right: 1px solid var(--borda) !important;
    }

    .v-card,
    .v-sheet {
        background: var(--azul-card) !important;
        color: var(--branco) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--borda) !important;
        border-radius: var(--raio) !important;
        box-shadow: var(--sombra) !important;
    }

    .nrdb-ui-group {
        background: rgba(3, 17, 35, 0.55) !important;
        border: 1px solid var(--borda) !important;
        border-radius: var(--raio) !important;
        box-shadow: var(--sombra) !important;
        padding: 12px !important;
    }

    .nrdb-ui-group__label {
        color: var(--branco) !important;
        font-size: 17px !important;
        font-weight: 850 !important;
        letter-spacing: 0.2px !important;
    }

    .v-field,
    .v-input,
    .v-text-field,
    .v-select,
    .v-label {
        color: var(--branco) !important;
    }

    .v-field {
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06) !important;
        border-radius: 10px !important;
    }

    .v-field__input,
    input,
    textarea,
    select {
        color: var(--branco) !important;
        font-weight: 600 !important;
    }

    .v-field__outline {
        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.30) !important;
    }

    .v-label {
        color: var(--cinza-texto) !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
    }

    .v-field__append-inner,
    .v-field__prepend-inner,
    .v-icon {
        color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85) !important;
    }

    .v-select__selection-text {
        color: #ffffff !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
    }

    .v-slider-track__background {
        background-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.22) !important;
    }

    .v-slider-track__fill {
        background-color: var(--laranja) !important;
    }

    .v-slider-thumb {
        color: var(--laranja) !important;
    }

    .v-switch .v-selection-control__input {
        color: var(--laranja) !important;
    }

    .v-btn {
        background-color: var(--laranja) !important;
        color: var(--branco) !important;
        font-weight: 850 !important;
        border-radius: 10px !important;
        letter-spacing: 0.2px !important;
    }

    .v-btn:hover {
        filter: brightness(1.08);
    }

    table {
        font-family: var(--fonte) !important;
    }

    code {
        font-family: Consolas, monospace !important;
    }

    .v-select__content {
        background: #071f3d !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 122, 0, 0.45) !important;
        border-radius: 10px !important;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.55) !important;
        overflow: hidden !important;
    }

    .v-select__content .v-list {
        background: #071f3d !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        padding: 4px !important;
    }

    .v-select__content .v-list-item {
        background: #071f3d !important;
        color: #ffffff !important;
        border-radius: 8px !important;
        margin: 2px 0 !important;
        min-height: 42px !important;
    }

    .v-select__content .v-list-item:hover {
        background: #0b315b !important;
    }

    .v-select__content .v-list-item-title {
        color: #ffffff !important;
        font-weight: 700 !important;
    }

    .v-select__content .v-list-item--active {
        background: #ff7a00 !important;
    }

    .v-select__content .v-list-item--active .v-list-item-title {
        color: #ffffff !important;
        font-weight: 900 !important;
    }

    .v-overlay-container {
        color: #ffffff !important;
    }
</style>
